title: Literature-constrained hierarchical reservoir experiment

immutable_parent.model_stage: 20260828_9; 20260828_10 is evaluation and release metadata only

model_location: rebuild routing from local_fast_response_m3_s and local_slow_response_m3_s; insert each reservoir once at its registered control edge after local runoff generation and before downstream routing; existing routed_* fields are parent-comparator outputs and must not be routed again

time_contract.state_spinup: 2006-2009 forcing only, matching the canonical is_spinup_period flag; excluded from scored likelihoods
time_contract.development_selection: 2016-2018 only; used to select R0/R1/R2 and lock parameters
time_contract.temporal_test: 2019-2022 opened only after model and parameter lock and reported only as a locked retrospective evaluation, not as a never-seen independent external validation
time_contract.extension: 2023-2024 generated only after the retrospective decision lock

first_run_boundary_contract.reservoir_surface_precipitation: fixed to zero for R1 and R2
first_run_boundary_contract.reservoir_surface_evaporation: fixed to zero for R1 and R2
first_run_boundary_contract.withdrawal: fixed to zero for R1 and R2
first_run_boundary_contract.reason: the frozen canonical parent already generates runoff over the full Reach area, so adding reservoir-surface P or E would double count water; a nonzero withdrawal is forbidden until source, intake, consumptive fraction, return fraction, return Reach and return lag are all registered
first_run_boundary_contract.future_activation: requires a separately registered experiment that removes reservoir area from the land forcing and/or registers a complete withdrawal-return pathway

registered_parameterization.target_curve: periodic low-dimensional baseline plus one flood-season drawdown window
per_reservoir_deviations: initial storage fraction with a literature/type prior
flood-season phase or width only when supported by evidence
registered_parameterization.hierarchy: operation type plus capacity-to-annual-inflow ratio plus basin and reservoir shrinkage
registered_parameterization.prior_sources: official regulation or design documents first, peer-reviewed reservoir-specific evidence second, GRanD and remote-sensing attributes third, generic model priors last
registered_parameterization.literature_ranges: legal operating ranges are truncation bounds; they are not automatically treated as 95 percent confidence intervals

initial_state_contract.pre_commissioning: exact parent bypass with zero reservoir storage
initial_state_contract.preferred_initialization: use a documented storage state at 2005-12-31 or the closest earlier observation that does not reveal a held-out outcome
initial_state_contract.active_at_2006_start_fallback: when no valid pre-2006 state exists, cycle the canonical 2006-2009 spinup forcing block through the reservoir operator until the registered storage-state convergence criterion is met, without scoring those years or using 2019-2022 or post-2022 data
initial_state_contract.initial_condition_sensitivity: repeat with at least low, target-centered and high physically admissible initial storage fractions; if evaluation-period states or decisions do not converge within the registered tolerance, mark initial_condition_confounded
initial_state_contract.commissioned_during_simulation: activate only on the registered impoundment and operation dates; use a documented filling phase when evidence exists, otherwise flag transition_unresolved
initial_state_contract.required_record: each reservoir records initialization_method, initialization_source_id, initialization_date, initial_storage_fraction, warmup_forcing_period, warmup_cycle_count and convergence_result

daily_order: generate frozen local fast and slow response for the current Reach-day
process reservoirs and ordinary Reaches in an audited upstream-to-downstream topological order
combine current-day upstream releases with current-day local response at each registered reservoir inflow
apply the reservoir water-balance and tracer update once at its unique control edge
route controlled release and emergency spill to downstream Reaches on the same day
routing_execution_contract.cascade_rule: an upstream reservoir release reaches a downstream reservoir on the same model day whenever the registered directed topology connects them without an explicit travel-time operator
routing_execution_contract.shared_storage_rule: one physical reservoir may register multiple true inflow control Reaches only when every control edge has routing fraction 1 and points to the same unique outflow Reach; enabled routing combines all fast, slow, direct and age-moment inputs, calls the storage operator once and releases once
routing_execution_contract.disabled_shared_storage_rule: when disabled, each real control edge remains an identity in the original topological addition order so bitwise parent reproduction is preserved
routing_execution_contract.graph_validation: the real 230-Reach downstream map and reservoir control-edge registry must be acyclic, directionally consistent and free of duplicate control edges before fitting

spill_claim_boundary.first_run_mode: unlimited emergency capacity-overflow spill sufficient to enforce storage <= registered capacity
spill_claim_boundary.upgrade_requirement: any finite spillway capacity, gated spill or event-operation claim requires a separately registered structure and evidence source

disabled_parent_reproduction_gate.scope: all 230 Reaches and every modeled day in the canonical product
disabled_parent_reproduction_gate.setup: disable every reservoir, reservoir-surface flux and withdrawal-return pathway, then rebuild routing from frozen local_fast_response_m3_s and local_slow_response_m3_s
disabled_parent_reproduction_gate.requirement: after sorting by Reach and date, the rebuilt routed fast, routed slow and routed total discharge must reproduce the canonical parent row by row with zero absolute difference; row keys, row count, null pattern and units must also be identical

completed_preflight_results.interpretation: The reservoir-aware routing framework can exactly recover the frozen parent when every registered priority reservoir is disabled; this does not authorize parameter fitting.

hard_constraints: one entity and one release location per reservoir
post-spill storage at or below registered capacity
daily water balance and fast-slow-direct tracer closure
no double routing through multi-Reach reservoir polygons
multi-arm shared reservoirs use one combined physical storage state and one release insertion
no post-processing of already accumulated routed_* flow; network routing is rebuilt from local fast and slow fluxes
withdrawal separate from controlled release and spill
water level not linearly converted to storage without an elevation-storage curve
R1 and R2 first-run reservoir-surface precipitation, evaporation and withdrawal fixed to zero
same-day upstream-to-downstream execution on the audited real topology
disabled-reservoir routing exactly reproduces the canonical parent across all 230 Reaches
prior_evidence_allowed: pre-2019 water-level rank and seasonal phase when no storage curve exists; prior-shape information only and never a likelihood
static design facts published later only when their effective date predates the held-out period and the source reveals no 2019-2022 operational outcome
diagnostics_only: all remotely sensed storage, storage-change, water-area and water-level series; forbidden from likelihoods, parameter fitting, prior-width tuning and candidate selection
2016-2018 storage diagnostics may be reported only after candidate definitions are registered and cannot select a remote-sensing algorithm
likelihoods_forbidden: 2019-2022 streamflow, release, water-level or storage outcomes during fitting
channels or diversions mislabeled as total reservoir release
downstream total water-supply demand assigned to individual upstream reservoirs without source evidence
the existing hswud_total_* product, which double counts derived urban-industrial withdrawal
post-2018 event reports used to tune flood-season rules

literature_leakage_contract.later_static_fact_exception: allowed only for immutable pre-existing design facts with field-level provenance
literature_leakage_contract.held_out_operation_outcomes: 2019-2022 storage, release, inflow, drought and flood event outcomes are forbidden during prior design

authorization_checklist: all modeled entities have unique routing control definitions
commissioning and impoundment dates are registered
Dongjiang and other multi-reservoir systems have an audited cascade/parallel graph
observation stations are classified as total release, component release, diversion, or downstream gauge
every numerical prior has a source, evidence grade and leakage status
2019-2022 files are hashed and access-locked for model selection
every reservoir has registered impoundment and operation dates or an explicit unresolved status
every active-at-start reservoir has an initialization source or a reproducible warmup and initial-condition sensitivity result
the real 230-Reach graph passes direction, acyclicity, cascade and control-edge validation
the all-reservoirs-disabled run passes exact row-by-row canonical parent reproduction

noninferiority_contract.evaluation_unit: locked 2019-2022 retrospective evaluation using the same station and aggregation definitions as the canonical parent report
noninferiority_contract.rule: all four limits must pass together; passing these limits establishes total-flow noninferiority only and cannot replace reservoir-specific release/storage or structural evidence

reservoir_specific_release_gate.eligible_observation: a station independently classified as total reservoir release or immediate downstream total flow; component outlets, channels, diversions and ambiguous station labels are excluded
reservoir_specific_release_gate.aggregation: monthly mean discharge computed from matched daily model values; months with less than 80 percent observation coverage are missing
reservoir_specific_release_gate.minimum_evidence: at least 3 distinct operator-ready reservoirs with at least 24 valid selection months each; otherwise status RELEASE_EVIDENCE_INSUFFICIENT and no empirical operation-rule claim is allowed
reservoir_specific_release_gate.comparison: R2 must be compared separately with R0 and R1 on identical reservoir-month rows
reservoir_specific_release_gate.pass_rule: for each reference the median per-reservoir primary-metric difference must be below 0, at least two thirds of eligible reservoirs must improve, and no eligible reservoir may worsen by more than 0.05 log-RMSE
reservoir_specific_release_gate.small_sample_uncertainty: use all paired reservoir-level sign flips when 3-12 reservoirs are eligible; bootstrap counts are descriptive and cannot manufacture spatial replication
reservoir_specific_release_gate.boundary_confounded: true if the same learned nonphysical deviation parameter reaches its registered truncation bound in at least ceil(N_reservoir/2) eligible reservoirs or if a system-level deviation reaches a bound in every development refit
reservoir_specific_release_gate.storage_evidence_role: remote water level, area and storage-change products remain post-selection diagnostics only until a separate observation-method contract is authorized; they cannot currently select R1 or R2

upgrade_rule: R2 may replace R0 only if all structural gates pass, all four explicit total-flow noninferiority limits pass against R0 and R1, the machine-executable reservoir-specific release gate passes against both references, and priors are not boundary-confounded. Remote storage products remain diagnostics and are not an upgrade gate in this experiment.
not_authorized_reason: All 13 priority artificial reservoirs now pass topology and activation pre-authorization; 12 are development-fit eligible and Datengxia is extension-only. Formal observation likelihood and parameter fitting remain closed until the synchronized pre-fit lock and observation-role audit are written. The 21 supplementary GRAnD dam points remain non-authoritative candidates.
